name: StationAPI Fix
description: Fixes the startup crash of StationAPI 2.0 on Android launchers (SIGSEGV in gl_swap_buffers): skips the buffer swap in StationAPI's early loading screen thread. The animated loading screen is not shown. Tested on Zalith Launcher 2 with StationAPI 2.0.0-alpha.6.4. Unofficial, not made by the StationAPI team.
